title.zh: 聊天 AI 是怎么“写”出一句话的
title.en: How a Chatbot Writes a Sentence

desc.zh: 一次只写一个 token：切字、数次数、把词变成数、注意力、温度采样和训练。八个在页面里真正运行的小模型，从零训练，不联网。
desc.en: One token at a time: splitting text, counting, turning words into numbers, attention, temperature sampling and training. Eight small models that really run in the page, trained from scratch, with no network.

desc.zh: 模型读写的单位是 token：把语料里最常挨着出现的一对反复合并，常见的词变成一个 token，罕见的拆成小块。
desc.en: Models read and write tokens: repeatedly merge the pair that sits together most often, so common words become one token and rare ones split into pieces.

en: why are AI prices per token
how many tokens is a word

title.zh: 预测下一个 token（二元模型）

desc.zh: 数一数每个 token 后面跟过什么，变成一张概率表，按表抽签就能一个一个往下写。
desc.en: Count what followed each token, turn the counts into a probability table, and draw from it to write one token after another.

en: does AI just predict the next word

title.zh: n 元模型与数据稀疏

desc.zh: 多看几个 token 句子更通顺，但在小语料上越看越像照抄，没见过的前文就查不到。
desc.en: Looking further back makes text smoother, but on a small corpus it turns into copying, and contexts never seen have no entry.

zh: 为什么不能只靠数次数
en: does AI copy its training data

title.zh: 词向量：把词变成一串数
title.en: Word vectors: words as lists of numbers

desc.zh: 按“周围出现什么词”给每个词一串数，用法相近的词数也相近，用余弦相似度就能找出近义的词。
desc.en: Give each word numbers from the words around it; words used alike get similar numbers, and cosine similarity finds their neighbours.

zh: AI怎么知道两个词意思相近
en: how does AI know words are similar

desc.zh: 每个位置拿查询去和前面各位置的键算点积，softmax 成权重，再按权重混合它们的值；“它”就是这样找到“苹果”的。
desc.en: Each position scores earlier positions by query·key, softmaxes the scores into weights and mixes their values; that is how 'it' finds 'apples'.

en: how does AI know what it refers to

desc.zh: 同一张概率表，温度把它压尖或摊平，top-k、top-p 砍掉尾巴；所以同一个问题每次的回答可以不一样。
desc.en: Temperature sharpens or flattens the same probability table, top-k and top-p cut its tail; that is why the same question can get different answers.

zh: 为什么AI回答每次不一样
en: why does AI give different answers

title.zh: 训练：用梯度下降压低交叉熵

desc.zh: 当场训练一个小网络：损失从“瞎猜”的 ln V 一路降到计数表的条件熵；学习率太大会发散，向量太短降不下去。
desc.en: Train a small network on the spot: the loss falls from guessing (ln V) to the conditional entropy of the counts; too large a step diverges, too short a vector stalls.

title.zh: 一次一个 token 的生成循环与规模

desc.zh: 看前文、给出概率表、抽一个、接上去，循环到句号；再对比本页模型与 GPT-3、Llama 3 公开的参数量和训练量。
desc.en: Read the context, produce a probability table, draw one, append, repeat until the full stop; then compare this page's models with the published sizes of GPT-3 and Llama 3.

en: why does AI make things up
